name: Custom Screen
author: hleawilliams-commits
summary: Your own deck-screen panels from a text file: readouts, 4-deck rekordbox waveforms and FlowVJ's status.
description: Up to four click-through panels on the deck screen with the readouts you pick: title, artist, key, BPM, BPMs that fit, pitch move, phrase meter from rekordbox's grid, time left, stems, clock, key wheels, zoomed 4-deck rekordbox waveforms (Mod Menu switch), FlowVJ status with tap buttons, the 4-deck phase strip and dead-air warnings (LOAD NEXT, ENDING, QUIET, DEAD AIR), so 4-Deck Phase Strip and Dead-Air Guard can be switched off to free screen space. Layout from layout.txt on the USB. No audio, tempo, key or library changes.
